plugins.name: smart-title
plugins.description: 对话演进时自动刷新会话标题：/smart-title 立即刷新、历史会话批量回填、手动改名永不覆盖。

description_i18n.zh-CN: 对话演进时自动刷新会话标题：/smart-title 立即刷新、历史会话批量回填、手动改名永不覆盖。
description_i18n.en: Refreshes session titles as the conversation evolves, plus manual refresh and batch backfill. Titles renamed by hand are never overwritten.
